thesis: The conversation explores Barry Sternlicht's career origins, noting that he entered real estate after graduating from Brown University and working as an arbitrage trader before attending Harvard Business School. He describes the market conditions of the early 1990s as a 'terrible time' to start investing due to the S&L crisis and inverted yields, which led to the failure of his previous firm and allowed him to begin his own investment career with a $21 million fund.
